verdict.rationale: Clerk markets built-in, continually updated ML bot detection with multi-account protection, and blocking of disposable email domains and '+' subaddresses to stop fraudulent sign-ups. It also claims built-in brute-force prevention for email and SMS one-time passcodes. However, the pack never mentions credential-stuffing defenses, and brute-force protection is only described for OTP delivery, not password sign-in. Missing for 10: credential-stuffing protection (e.g. breached-password detection), brute-force or lockout protection on password sign-in, in-depth documentation beyond marketing pages, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
